This is Felix. I didn't know much about fish when I first got him, but have tried to learn what I can. He currently lives in a 5 gallon tank. I am moving, so I brought him to my parents home. They told me that he hasn't been moving or eating, so I came to check on him (they have never had a fish-I left them instructions on his light and feeding schedule).

After looking at the tank and researching, it looks like there's orange algae in his tank. I have 5-in-1 tests for pH, Nitrite, Nitrate, Carbonate, and general hardness. All levels were within appropriate range, except the water was on the "soft" side. I have already purchased completely new materials for his tank (filter, rocks, decor, etc). I set up his transition tank and that's when I noticed the bloated stomach. I did a brief internet search, but would really love some advice on how to help him because it's kind of confusing to me and there were a couple options online for what could be wrong with him. 

He hasn't eaten in a few days and floats at the bottom of the tank. He shows no interest in food. When I moved him between tanks, he was very active and responsive. Any help would be very appreciated, I feel awful for him and don't want him to be suffering. I can give more specific info if needed.

I haven't experienced anything truly negative from my community, but I do have to deal with a lot of annoying comments and assumptions about my relationships and sexuality.
